thread.title: Qualcomm To Cut 1,500 Jobs To Help Stave Off Broadcom Merger

author: BLOOMBERG NEWS
title: Qualcomm To Cut 1,500 Jobs To Help Stave Off Broadcom Merger
text:
Qualcomm ( QCOM ) will cut 1,500 jobs in California, or 4.4% of its work force, with the majority of the jobs to be cut at the chipmaker's San Diego headquarters, according to documents filed with the state on Thursday.
X 
Some 1,231 positions will be eliminated in San Diego with terminations starting about June 19. The company delivered the news in a WARN, or Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification, notice. At the same time, about 269 workers will lose their jobs at the company's Santa Clara and San Jose locations.
Reports said Qualcomm had 33,800 full- and part-time workers as of last September. Companies are required to make such a state filing when they reduce their workforce by 50 or more employees within a 30-day period.
The largest maker of smartphone chips pledged in January that it would slash $1 billion in expenses. The plan was to improve earnings, part of its efforts to fight off a hostile takeover bid from rival Broadcom ( AVGO ).

They include a legal dispute with Apple ( AAPL ) over patent royalties and a pending offer to buy NXP Semiconductors ( NXPI ). Shareholders have urged the company to buy back shares, reports said.
Qualcomm's annual sales have fallen every year since 2015 and are projected to decline 3% in fiscal 2018.
